title: Timing wrong-signer vector expects BAD_SIGNATURE for a valid signature
description: Correctness review: generate_packets_timing.py builds signed-wrong-signer by signing canonical_payload with wrong_identity and publishes that identity as signer_pubkey_hex (around lines 388-397); packets-timing.json:488-494 nevertheless expects link_receive/BAD_SIGNATURE. python/tests/test_protocol_vector_security.py:114-132 independently verifies every timing wire against its published signer key, so this signature is demonstrably valid. Because the IPv6 source IID belongs to remote_identity, the proper failure is source_signer_mismatch after cryptographic authentication if wrong_identity is trusted, or an unknown/untrusted-signer error if it is not. Regenerate with the intended trust setup and assert the exact valid rejection stage/cause.
